original_title: Welcome to new group member Stefan Buschmann
original_content_full:
Welcome to new group member Stefan Buschmann

We warmly welcome Stefan Buschmann as a new member and PhD student in our Computer Graphics Systems group. Stefan received a degree in computer science from the Technical University of Braunschweig in 2007 and has been working as a software developer and engineer within various projects, e.g., in the field of interactive 3D simulations. As a member of the CGS group, Stefan plans to research on interactive 3D visualization applications and systems.
